root_idea.summary: The root denotes Abqar and its nisba عَبْقَرِيّ, associated with extraordinary quality, fine workmanship, and exceptional distinction; in the Qur'an it names a type of richly made carpet or furnishing.
root_idea.development: The lexical development proceeds from the name of a legendary place associated with jinn to a nisba meaning remarkable or excellent, especially in craftsmanship or quality. The Qur'anic usage specializes this designation as a carpet or furnishing term.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The sole Quran-attested form is a distinct nominalized nisba used for a carpet or furnishing term.

senses.definition: A richly made, variegated, or figured carpet or floor covering.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Qur'anic expression وَعَبْقَرِيٍّ حِسَانٍ, the nisba noun is used substantivally for a type of carpet or furnishing. Classical explanations include thick figured carpets, brocade, and zarabi.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A legendary place associated with jinn; the name is also reported for a desert locality or a town.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This place-name is the basis of the nisba عَبْقَرِيٌّ. The geographical identification is reported in more than one way.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Remarkable, admirable, or excellent in workmanship or quality; fine, delicate, complete, or exceptionally strong.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied broadly to things admired for their quality or manufacture. The lexical evidence also applies it to such examples as an animal or a jewel, without restricting the meaning to those classes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pure, unmixed lie, containing no truth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized classical usage for a lie wholly devoid of truth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A chief or lord of a people; a person without a superior, or a powerful and pre-eminent man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in descriptions of a man's rank, authority, or strength, including the expression عَبْقَرِيُّ قَوْمٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Extreme or superlative in a given quality.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May denote an exceptionally high degree whether favorable or unfavorable; classical usage includes describing wrongdoing as extreme.

cautions: Classical evidence records variant readings and variant analyses of the form, including عَبَاقِرِيّ and عَبَاقَرِيّ; these are not presented as separate public Quranic forms.
The identification of Abqar as a particular geographical place is reported inconsistently and should not be treated as a secure modern location.
